title: Keep releases tidy (commercial Mandate 95), in the active contract
goal: Vision: V-20. Directive 2026-11-16: agents must keep releases tidy. The rule lands in core's active contract after the production-release rules: each version cut once and never moved; tag, record and qualification record published together and agreeing; each release says what it ships; a candidate line opened only when none serves, never moved or deleted by an agent; local release leftovers removed once published. Pinned in tests/architecture_tests.rs.

reuse.searched: Inside Susi: tests/release_records.rs holds each record's content and tag commit and that qualification records belong to records; release_version_guard holds one version, one cut; the active contract already makes tags immutable and requires installed-release sync; the commercial workflow releases verb (susi-commercial-apps Mandate 95) reports the newest release's record and qualification, mismatches and candidate states. This adds one contract rule and one brief sentence; no new code.
